title: HeroSignatureCrownmarksSchema
description: Validation schema mapping heroes directly to their high-affinity historical signature crownmarks.

hero_signature_mappings.description: Affinity metadata mappings for individual commander synergies.

hero_id.description: Unique index key matching the core database (e.g. maegan).

signature_crownmark_ids.description: Array of item IDs that qualify as signature pieces.

unlocked_milestone.description: In-game achievement required to begin tracking affinity milestones.

affinity_lore_unlocked.description: Key-value dictionary mapping milestone levels (e.g., level_1, level_3, level_5) to unlocked story narratives.
